name: FlickDirect Connect: Movie MCP Server
tagline: Movie MCP server for facts, news, reviews, podcasts and videos, with original source links.
description: FlickDirect Inc’s free, read-only movie MCP server provides movie and TV facts, available country-specific dates/ratings, trivia, brief quote excerpts, news, reviews, interviews and eligible stored transcripts. Live service 1.5.6 adds recent uploads from three published YouTube channels and bounded FlickRadio archive discovery. Streaming, soundtrack/player, app-store, retailer and daily-deal destinations preserve published affiliate parameters and may include digital offers; Connect does not perform checkout. Responses provide bounded source information and original page links, not full articles/reviews/transcripts or photographs. The advertised tools are search_flickdirect_content and get_flickdirect_movie_details. Cached search_fdmd and get_fdmd_movie calls remain compatible at the same endpoint. No FlickDirect account or API key is required; host application requirements and tool selection still apply.

install.notes: Uses Streamable HTTP without authentication. Ask for a title and release year to distinguish similarly named films. Follow and cite FlickDirect source links. The linked repository contains public plugin metadata and setup guidance, not the proprietary service implementation.
